findings.issue: נִדָּה is a common noun (H5079), left untranslated as nidá.
Hithpael imperfect 3ms of lemma 2398 is the thing purifying itself; se pecará makes a sinning event.
אַךְ is tagged affirmation; solo narrows it to restrictive only.

notes: 2mp hiphil harán is ustedes address; fire and waters match the ב phrases.
